ops.title: pocket-llm npm library (yasyf/pocket-llm) — three-lane browser LLM sessions; live on GitHub, v0.1.0 publish blocked ONLY on user npm auth
ops.body:
`~/Code/pocket-llm` / github.com/yasyf/pocket-llm — extracted from the captain-hook docs LLM lane (user directive 2026-07-21). Bun-layer bootstrap, PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 (user's pick over MIT), public, tagline verbatim on five surfaces. API: `detect()` → `{lane, availability, model, downloadBytes}` (never downloads; webllm/wllama always report needs-download); `createSession({system, responseSchema, onProgress, models, assets, lanes})` → `session.prompt()`/`destroy()`; lane chain prompt-api → webllm (WebGPU) → wllama (CPU WASM, single-thread n_threads:1, consumer-supplied `assets.wllama` wasm URLs, no hardcoded CDN); structured output via responseConstraint / response_format json_schema / `jsonSchemaToGbnf` (subset converter, throws PocketLlmError beyond it). Defaults: Gemini Nano (built-in) / SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-q0f16-MLC (~269MB) / unsloth SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-GGUF Q4_K_M (~105MB).

**Why:** captain-hook Phase 4b pins this exact package from npm — no file:/link deps in committed lockfiles.

**How to apply:** v0.1.0 is fully ready on main (36 tests, CI green, release-npm.yml with tag↔version guard + OIDC trusted publishing). First publish needs a one-time pending trusted publisher on npmjs.com (package pocket-llm, repo yasyf/pocket-llm, workflow release-npm.yml) or `npm login`; then push tag v0.1.0 and CI publishes with provenance. Quirks: `@wllama/wllama` is mispackaged — import the `@wllama/wllama/esm/index.js` subpath (types AND runtime; bun test mocks must register that same specifier). The cc-guides shim renders AGENTS.md in CI (local binary may lag the bot's version — commit the fragment and push). `capt-hook review enable` fails machine-globally (review DB needs manual v1 migration) and `cc-notes init` half-fails (shells a retired `capt-hook pack add` subcommand) — both deferred, not repo problems.
